[[File:Cursed goblin hammer detail.png|left|120px]]
The '''cursed goblin hammer''' is one of the three [[cursed goblin weapon]]s released during the [[Goblin Invasion]] event. It was originally a drop from the [[goblin lieutenant]]s found in the cave that the [[Varrock]] [[Scout (2013 Goblin Invasion)|scout]] led you to, and it was very powerful when used against [[goblin]]s fought during the event. It can now be bought from [[Diango]] in [[Draynor Village]] for 45 [[coins]]. It is considered a [[Fun weapons|fun weapon]].

Its -100 [[Strength bonus]] makes it the weakest melee weapon in the game, tied with the [[hunting knife]], [[carrot sword]], and [[nutcracker staff]]. If the user's Strength bonus is -64 or less, it will never deal damage.
